scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Validate the hero section displays MirDB logo, tagline, and primary call-to-action buttons correctly

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage URL
steps.context: User visits the homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that the animated MirDB logo (logo.gif) is visible and properly rendered
Confirm the headline 'MirDB: A Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' is displayed
steps.context: Tagline should communicate persistence + memcached compatibility

steps.description: Check that 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub' buttons are visible and clickable
steps.context: Primary and secondary CTAs should be prominent

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains logo.gif image element with proper src attribute
Page contains headline with 'MirDB' and 'Persistent Key-Value Store' text
Two CTA buttons present: 'Get Started' (primary) and 'View on GitHub' (secondary)
Button links to https://github.com/yetone/mirdb

scenarios.name: Value Proposition Section
scenarios.description: Validate the three-column value proposition section clearly communicates MirDB's key benefits

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the value proposition area of the homepage
steps.context: Section should be visible after hero section

steps.description: Confirm a three-column layout is displayed on desktop viewport
steps.context: Each column represents one key benefit

steps.description: Check that each column displays: Memcached Protocol Support, Persistence, and LSM Tree Architecture

test_cases.expected: Section contains three distinct column elements for benefits display
Page contains text about Memcached protocol compatibility and drop-in replacement
Page contains text about data persistence and surviving restarts
Page contains text about LSM Tree architecture for efficient storage

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Validate the features section displays implemented and planned features correctly

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the features area of the homepage
Check that async networking, memtable, and compaction features are displayed
steps.context: Implemented features: Tokio async, memtable with skip list, minor/major compaction

steps.description: Check that Raft consensus is shown as a planned/upcoming feature
steps.context: Visual indicator should distinguish planned from implemented

test_cases.expected: Page displays 'async networking' or 'Tokio' as an implemented feature
Page displays 'memtable' or 'skip list' as an implemented feature
Page displays 'minor compaction' and 'major compaction' as implemented features
Page displays 'Raft' consensus as a planned/upcoming feature with visual distinction

scenarios.name: Quick Start Guide Section
scenarios.description: Validate the quick start guide provides clear installation and usage instructions

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the quick start guide area
Check that installation commands or instructions are displayed
steps.context: Should include clear steps to get MirDB running

steps.description: Check that example memcached commands are shown (SET, GET, DELETE)

test_cases.expected: Quick start section contains code block elements with installation commands
Page displays SET command example in code format
Page displays GET command example in code format
Page displays DELETE command example in code format

scenarios.name: Usage Demonstration Section
scenarios.description: Validate the usage demonstration GIF is properly embedded and displayed

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the usage demonstration area
steps.context: Demo section showcases MirDB in action

steps.description: Check that the usage.gif animation is visible and playing
Check that a descriptive caption explains what the demo shows
steps.context: Caption should help users understand the demonstration

test_cases.expected: Demo section contains image element with usage.gif source
Usage.gif has descriptive alt text for accessibility
Demo section includes caption text explaining the demonstration

scenarios.name: Navigation and Header
scenarios.description: Validate the header navigation provides clear access to key sections and external links

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage
steps.context: Header should be visible at top of page

steps.description: Check that a compact MirDB logo is displayed in the header
steps.context: Logo should link to homepage or top of page

steps.description: Check that navigation links for Features, Quick Start, Documentation, and GitHub are present
steps.context: Links should be accessible and functional

test_cases.expected: Page contains a header element with navigation
Header contains link to Features section (anchor or smooth scroll)
Header contains link to Quick Start section
Header contains external link to GitHub repository

scenarios.name: Footer Section

steps.context: Footer should be visible at page bottom

Check that license information is displayed

test_cases.expected: Page contains a footer element
Footer contains link to https://github.com/yetone/mirdb
Footer displays license information or link to license

scenarios.name: CI Status Badge Display
scenarios.description: Validate the CircleCI status badge is displayed and links correctly

steps.description: Find the CircleCI status badge on the homepage
steps.context: Badge should be visible in hero section

steps.description: Check that the badge image loads and displays build status
steps.context: Badge should show current CI/CD status

steps.description: Check that clicking the badge navigates to CircleCI build page
steps.context: Should link to project's CircleCI dashboard

test_cases.expected: Page contains image element with CircleCI badge source URL
Badge is wrapped in link pointing to CircleCI project page

scenarios.name: Supported Commands Display
scenarios.description: Validate the supported memcached commands are displayed correctly

steps.description: Find the section displaying supported memcached commands
steps.context: Should list all supported protocol commands

steps.description: Check that SET, ADD, REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND are listed
Check that GET, GETS are listed
Check that INFO, MAJOR_COMPACTION are listed

test_cases.input: Check for SET command in documentation
test_cases.expected: Page displays SET as a supported storage command

test_cases.input: Check for GET command in documentation
test_cases.expected: Page displays GET as a supported retrieval command

test_cases.input: Check for DELETE command in documentation
test_cases.expected: Page displays DELETE as a supported deletion command
Page displays INFO and MAJOR_COMPACTION as MirDB-specific commands

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Mobile
scenarios.description: Validate the homepage displays correctly on mobile devices (320px-767px viewport)

steps.description: Resize browser to mobile viewport (375px width)
Check that all content fits within viewport without horizontal scrolling
Check that navigation transforms to mobile-friendly format (hamburger menu or similar)
steps.context: Navigation should be accessible on mobile

steps.description: Check that all text is readable without zooming
steps.context: Font sizes should be appropriate for mobile

test_cases.expected: Page renders without horizontal scrollbar

test_cases.input: Check value proposition columns on mobile
test_cases.expected: Three columns stack vertically on mobile viewport
Navigation is accessible via mobile-friendly menu (hamburger or collapsed)
Logo and demo GIF scale appropriately for mobile viewport

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Tablet
scenarios.description: Validate the homepage displays correctly on tablet devices (768px-1023px viewport)

steps.description: Resize browser to tablet viewport (768px width)
Check that layout adapts appropriately for tablet size
steps.context: May use different grid or column arrangement

steps.description: Check that all homepage sections render correctly
steps.context: No content should be cut off or overlapping

test_cases.expected: Page renders correctly with appropriate tablet layout
Value proposition section displays in two or three columns
Buttons and links have adequate touch target size (44px minimum)

scenarios.name: Performance - Page Load Time

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Color Contrast

CTA button text has at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against button background

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Semantic HTML

test_cases.expected: Page contains exactly one h1 element

Page contains header, main, and footer landmark elements
